snippet.title: A Tale of Silent Depths | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
A Tale of Silent Depths
A Tale of Silent Depths is a turn based tactical RPG set in a post-apocalyptic underwater setting. Explore a procedurally generated Ocean, command your submarine and fight beasts, pirates and creatures beyond your crew's comprehension.
